name: Steakhouse Confidential Prime USDC
oneLiner: steakcUSDC is Steakhouse's public USDC vault share behind a confidential deposit surface; withdrawals use liquid USDC and losses reduce NAV.
collateral: USDC in the Steakhouse-curated Morpho Vault V2 on ethereum, held idle or lent through its MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2; borrower collateral and credit losses remain local strategy exposure
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue net USDC lending interest and realize losses at NAV. Ordinary withdraw/redeem uses idle USDC and the configured liquidity adapter, subject to liquidity; force-deallocation and in-kind exits are separate, not guaranteed dollar settlement. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0.001% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Steakhouse Confidential Prime USDC (steakcUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeef00a59b577423653a1526c7009bde103f542b is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x17bc9aa135cef1a5c3a91925e0f865d526318718 holds 3 enumerated Morpho market IDs. This intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent and older Morpho precedent classifications. The public share contract was created June 19, 2026; Zama announced public deposits open June 23, 2026, the product launchDate. Zama cShare 0x66bf74e96900d1a19c7070d939d124f2f565c458 is a separate confidential wrapper, not another native deployment of this public share.
